name: PTQU - PeerTube Quick Upload
description: Queue web page URLs as video imports on your PeerTube server.

upload-current-url.description: Queue current page URL for import

data_types.description: URL and title of the web page the user chooses to import
data_types.purpose: To send the URL to the user's PeerTube server for video import
data_types.retention_period: Temporarily stored in browser storage until processed, then removed

data_types.description: Username, password, and OAuth tokens for the user's PeerTube server
data_types.purpose: To authenticate API requests to the user's PeerTube instance
data_types.retention_period: Stored in local extension storage until user disconnects or clears data

data_types.description: The user triggering video imports from pages they're viewing
data_types.purpose: To capture current page information when the user activates the extension
data_types.retention_period: Not retained after the import request is sent to the server
